They were promulgated by the ABA House of Delegates upon the recommendation of the Kutak Commission in 1983 .

`` Rip It Up '' was a 1983 single by Scottish post-punk band Orange Juice . It was the second single to be released from their 1982 album of the same name . The song became the band 's only UK top 40 success , reaching no . 8 in the chart .
